title: Mutational constraints on RSV F and its neutralization by antibodies
description:
Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11030-4

How respiratory syncytial virus mutations affect antibody neutralization is defined, and a biophysical model of the mechanism is provided, to show how Fab potency and epitope specificity combine to determine the effects of viral mutations on antibody neutralization.
